title: The I3322 quantum value: a certified two-sided window and correction record
description: A post-release exact-arithmetic audit found a load-bearing global-amplitude gap in the Bellman upper-bound assembly of the earlier releases (v1.0.0-v1.2.0). Those releases are preserved as historical records; their exact-optimum, nonattainment, spatial-separation, and nonclosure claims are under correction and are not asserted by this version. What this version rigorously and unconditionally certifies: 0.2508753845015185 < omega_tensor <= omega_commuting <= 0.250875388108398 (window width 3.61e-9), with the lower endpoint an explicit 255-dimensional rational tensor-product strategy verified in exact arithmetic and independently reconstructed at 160-digit interval precision, and the upper endpoint an exact rational Bellman subsolution with an endpoint-clustered 25,601-knot witness, independently reconstructed cell by cell. The certificate stack, the audit that found the gap, a structural explanation (Bellman contact versus amplitude-normalization duality), and one recorded failed quantitative prediction are all included. Every load-bearing claim maps to replayable source and a frozen receipt.
